forms.pitch: A sanity meter that also affects the menus, the subtitles and eventually the credits.
forms.connects: The worse it gets, the less you can trust your own {mechanic.noun}.

forms.pitch: Your {protagonist.noun} keeps a diary, and the entries get more unhinged every night.
forms.connects: Diary entries hide clues about {threat.noun} that you only spot on a re-read.

forms.pitch: A hotline for the dead: callers give you hints, most of them wrong.
forms.connects: Trusting the right caller saves {resource.noun}; trusting the wrong one feeds {threat.noun}.

forms.pitch: An exorcism minigame with forty-two Latin verbs to conjugate under pressure.
forms.connects: Every successful rite clears a room and buys you a little peace from {threat.noun}.

forms.pitch: Run haunted tours {setting.in} and scare paying visitors for extra {resource.noun}.
forms.connects: Screams pay the bills, and the bills keep the lights on against {threat.noun}.

forms.pitch: A jump-scare editor so players can ambush each other's saves.
forms.connects: Community scares keep the core loop terrifying long after you know the map.

forms.pitch: Sixty collectible cursed dolls, each with a backstory and a grudge.
forms.connects: Every doll you find makes the {setting.noun} a little worse, which is exactly the point.

forms.pitch: Let {threat.noun} leave passive-aggressive notes whenever you escape.
A ghost-matchmaking side story: find every spirit {setting.in} a nice afterlife partner.
A comfort setting that lets you pet the monster. It purrs. The game becomes ten percent less scary.

pitchThreat.text: Lock the doors and count your {resource.noun}, because {threat.clause}.

badIdea.text: Mixing {mechanic.noun} with {threat.noun} means playtesters will scream, though not always for the right reasons.

mightWork.text: But [a] {setting.noun} is a perfect place to be afraid, and {mechanic.noun} will have players holding their breath.
